نستكري (form X)
# نَسْتَكْرِي (nastakrī) /nas.tak.riː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْرَى (istakrā)
# نَسْتَكْرِيَ (nastakriya) /nas.tak.ri.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَكْرَى (istakrā)
